card.name: Inside interleukin and similar long words
card.fires_on: The last piece of 'interleukin' just before a hyphen and number (e.g. interleukin-6), and similar partway pieces of long words like 'Tuscany' and 'immunoglobulins'. Also some Lao script characters.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The 'in' piece closing 'interleuk' before a hyphen and number or a bracketed abbreviation.

modes.label: Other split long words
modes.description: Middle pieces of rarer words such as place names or immunoglobulins.
modes.example: the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med

modes.label: Lao script
modes.description: A Lao vowel character inside a Lao word in a national motto.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ

card.plain: It marks the end of the word interleukin, as in interleukin-6, and a few other long split words.
